title: Chapter 21: One-Star Knight
content:
Chapter 21: One-Star Knight

More than 300 monsters over three meters high appeared on the battlefield, and the huge mace turned into a small stick in their hands.

Faced with such a monster attack, the puppy can only use its flexible body to continuously dodge and find the right opportunity to launch a counterattack.

In this case, the battlefield can no longer be restricted.

Wu Qing ordered the puppy and the hydralisk to start a mobile battle.

Although the mad bugbear soldiers can still distinguish between ourselves and the enemy and will not kill each other, they have indeed lost their minds and cannot understand commands.

There are advantages to being large, but there are also disadvantages in that they are not as nimble as small dogs.

From positional blocking warfare to mobile warfare, the puppy's advantages were brought into play again.

After attracting the mad bugbear soldiers to scatter, several puppies gathered together to attack a mad bugbear together.

The Hydralisk phalanx was also dispersed into several small groups to contain them remotely, creating opportunities for the puppies to encircle and kill them.

There were less than a hundred soldiers in the bugbear army who had not gone berserk, and they all retreated to the bugbear priests.

Having lost the advantage of the military formation, the dispersed mad bugbear soldiers were, in Wu Qing's eyes, an active resource bank, waiting for the Zerg to harvest them.

The battlefield entered a time-consuming mobile siege mode, and one by one the powerful berserk bugbear soldiers fell under the siege of the puppies.

The Zerg puppies are still coming for reinforcements in a steady stream.

"The situation is over, let's go!"

The miracle that the bugbear priest was waiting for did not appear. The enemies that kept appearing made him understand that such enemies were no longer something he could deal with.

Retreating became the best option. Go back and report the information here to the higher ups for processing.

"Master Sacrifice, I will cut off the queen!"

One of the knights said.

The bugbear priest nodded, said, "May the spirit god bless you!", then turned and left with the ten guardian knights.

The knights in the back came to the bugbear knights, who numbered less than 100, and shouted: "For the glory of the Spirit God! Fight!".

"war!"

"war!"

"war!"

The bugbear knights echoed in unison.

Even if they are defeated, even if they stay and die, the morale of these bugbear soldiers is still so high!

"These soldiers armed with faith are really terrifying!"

Wu Qing lamented to himself that without a system, he would not be able to train such an army.

"But I can't let you run away like this!"

Wu Qing didn't want the bugbear priest to bring back the Zerg situation. He also needed the luck of the one-star creature to upgrade the Zerg base.

The puppies who were surrounding and killing the mad bugbear soldiers on the battlefield all gave up their goals and chased in the direction of the bugbear sacrifice.

The berserk bugbear soldiers were left to the hydralisks to fly their kites, slowly grinding them to death.

The bugbear knights who took the initiative to cut off the rear saw the puppies pursuing them, and led the remaining normal bugbear soldiers to stop them. A dozen of the chasing puppy groups went to entangle the bugbear soldiers who had cut off the rear, and the large army continued to pursue.

A puppy with an upgraded movement speed can run very fast, but the bugbear knight's lizard mount is not a mount known for its speed.

The speed at which a lizard can carry people is completely incomparable to the speed at which a puppy can pursue it.

The bugbear priest's secret techniques are also endless. He also consumes faith energy to increase the speed of the lizard mount, making up for some of the speed gaps with the puppy.

But the secret technique that consumes faith is not omnipotent. The basic gap is too big, even if there is a gain, it will not help.

The puppy group soon approached the bugbear priest's cavalry team.

Behind the group of puppies, there was a continuous stream of puppies chasing them, as well as a dozen hosts that were not slow flying over from the sky.

As long as it is entangled by the puppy, the attacks from behind will be continuous. No matter how strong the bugbear priest is, it will be difficult to escape and ascend to heaven.

"I want to see how much faith energy you have! Let's see if your god allows you to waste it like this!"

Wu Qing discovered that as long as the bugbear sacrifice consumes faith energy due to this war, the system will increase a lot of energy resources. This is the power of material-energy conversion under the relationship of cause and effect.

Wu Qing wants to exhaust the value of this bugbear sacrifice!

When the puppy chasing at the front was about to catch up, the Bugbear Priest gave the ten guardian knights another buff.

The leader of the guardian knight took the initiative to fall at the end of the team. He looked particularly tall and strong. Only then did he reveal his true strength. He was also a strong man who had reached the stars.

"You protect the priest and leave first, I will come later!"

The one-star Bugbear Knight, who received the blessing of the sacrifice, instantly burst out with powerful combat power and launched a countercharge towards the pursuing puppy.

The puppies who were rushing at the front were all knocked far away by him with one blow and lost the ability to move.

The puppies behind were unable to come up and entangle them. There were not enough of them, and they would be beaten away if they tried to come up. They could only follow at a distance.

The one-star knight blocked the puppy for a while, and then the army of puppies behind him was about to rush forward. He rode a strong lizard mount and turned around to leave.

His speed is much faster than other knights, which shows that his lizard mount is also extraordinary.

More and more puppies were catching up behind them. Some of them continued to follow the one-star knight, while the other puppies spread out, preparing to overtake them from both sides and chase the bugbear priests ahead.

The one-star knight ran for a while and found that he ran further and brought the puppies to the sacrifice.

He had to choose to stop and continue blocking.

But two fists are no match for four hands, and the puppy won't fight him head-on, but wanders around him, leaving him running for his life.

As a knight, he does not have the ability of a priest to consume the energy of faith to perform secret arts. His strength lies in his own strength.

This is somewhat in line with Wu Qing's normal understanding. Anyone who manipulates the power of rules at every turn is cheating like him.

10 puppies gathered around the one-star knight and suddenly attacked the knight in tacit agreement. The other puppies quickly rushed from both sides and chased in the direction of the bugbear sacrifice.

The 10 flexible puppies, imaginary and real, wanted to use their agility to find opportunities to attack. This tactic lost its effect in front of the one-star knight.

The one-star knight's speed and strength have been qualitatively improved. He can also simply absorb the energy of the world for his own use. A small amount of energy can be stored in his body to provide support for his physical recovery and long-lasting combat.

Every attack from the puppies can be detected by him and he can deal with it calmly.

"The strength of one star in this world has indeed improved a lot. In this situation, we can only rely on numbers to kill him."

Wu Qing saw the situation of the one-star knight through the puppy's vision.

"The Insect Queen should be able to deal with him easily, but it is a rare opportunity to test the gap between the power levels in this world."

More and more puppies were surrounding the one-star bugbear knight, and they only waited for Wu Qing's order to launch a siege.
